title: Absa raises Kenya unit stake to 72% through tender offer
desc: JOHANNESBURG, Aug 19 (Reuters) – South Africa’s Absa Group said on Wednesday it had acquired about 3.5% of its Kenya unit through a tender offer, lifting its stake to roughly 72%.
